password.own_hint: Change your own password from Password in the top bar. That page asks for your current password.
login.point_bank: Bank statements match donations and expenses
login.point_receipts: Receipts and food coupons print as PDF
login.point_subscription: Subscription invoices include a devotee payment link
login.sub: Use your staff or admin account.

contributors.view_only: Only an Admin can add or change a contributor.
contributors.photo_keep: Leave the photo empty to keep the current one.

reports.bank_note: Bank transactions matched or still open
reports.donations_note: All donations, filterable by date range
reports.expenses_note: All expenses, filterable by date range
reports.intro: Every report opens in a print-friendly view with a Print button. Use the browser print dialog to save a PDF or send it to a printer.
reports.title: Available reports
settings.choices_intro: Add a choice with the form. Update or remove it in the table. The same name cannot be added twice in one list. Puja offerings, prasadam, and bookable service prices for coupons and the public booking site are managed under Online booking › Catalog & pricing—not here.
settings.approval_intro: A Staff member can approve up to the Staff limit. A Treasurer can approve up to the Treasurer limit. Above that, an Admin decides. The Staff limit cannot be higher than the Treasurer limit. Zero means that role cannot approve an amount.
settings.approval_scope: Only an Admin can change these limits.
settings.identity_intro: One name, place, and logo for the menu, coupons, receipts, and the email signature. On coupons and receipts the logo is also printed as a watermark.
settings.identity_scope: Saving here updates the temple name, place, logo, and watermark only.
settings.label: Label
settings.logo_hint: Any image file, up to 2 MB. PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, SVG, HEIC, and other image types are accepted. Leave this empty to keep the current logo.
settings.messages_intro: Outgoing mail for invoices and receipt emails, and the note that opens in WhatsApp Web.
settings.hub.intro: Choose a category below. Only one section is shown at a time so the page stays easy to scan.
settings.hub.identity_desc: Temple name, place, logo, PDF watermarks
settings.hub.messages_desc: Outgoing email and WhatsApp Web template
settings.hub.choices_desc: Dropdown lists used across ERP forms
settings.hub.booking_desc: Public booking site, rules, Razorpay, WhatsApp
settings.online_booking_intro: Public puja booking, invoices, Razorpay, and WhatsApp templates. Prasadam menu and service prices are linked below.
settings.ob_links_hint: Day-to-day operations stay in Booking admin; catalog and prices are edited here or in linked screens.
settings.ob_prasadam_hint: Shown when devotees add food / prasadam on the public booking site. New prices apply to new bookings only.
settings.ob_prasadam_intro: Each row is one coupon category (name, price per person, max persons per booking). Printed serial coupons are managed separately under Food coupons.
settings.ob_prasadam_readonly: Only Admin or Treasurer can change the menu.
settings.ob_prasadam_missing_table: Run Booking migrations on this database to create food_coupon_catalog.
settings.ob_prasadam_saved: Prasadam menu saved. New prices apply to new bookings only.
settings.ob_prasadam_edit_in_settings: Edit in Settings › Online booking › Prasadam menu
settings.ob_services_hint: Puja and ceremony prices, rules, extra fields, and time slots for the public booking form.
settings.ob_availability_hint: Block festival or closure dates; see how full each slot is on a given day.
settings.ob_availability_intro: Closing a date stops new bookings only; existing bookings are unchanged.
settings.ob_group_catalog_desc: What devotees can book online — puja services, prices, and prasadam menu items. Food › Coupons uses these names and prices when you generate printed coupons (refresh the Coupons page after changes). Legacy puja purposes from the old Choices list are imported automatically as Services (reload this page once if you still miss names).
settings.ob_legacy_import_pending: Some names from the old Settings › Choices › Puja purpose list are not in the database yet. Save or reload this page — they will be added under Services automatically.
settings.ob_group_schedule_desc: Closed dates and how full slots are on a given day.
settings.ob_group_site_desc: Contact details, terms, and booking number rules shown on the devotee form.
settings.ob_group_integrations_desc: Razorpay status (server config) and WhatsApp templates for devotees and staff.
settings.ob_service_saved: Service saved. Price changes apply to new bookings only.
settings.ob_service_remove_confirm: Remove this service and all its time slots? This cannot be undone.
settings.ob_prices_review: Service prices may still be installation placeholders. Review each row, edit as needed, then confirm.
settings.ob_to_hint: Leave same as From for one day
settings.ob_slots_edit_hint: Edit slot labels, capacities and weekdays on each service (Edit).
settings.ob_price_hint: Use 0 when the temple confirms charges later on the booking page.
settings.ob_rule_slot: Devotee must choose a time slot
settings.ob_daily_cap: Max bookings per day (empty = no limit)
settings.ob_extra_fields_hint: Leave label empty to remove a field. For choices, comma-separate options.
settings.ob_slots_form_hint: Capacity = bookings per slot on one date (empty = unlimited). Untick weekdays when not offered.
settings.ob_contact_hint: Shown on the public booking site, invoices, and messages.
settings.ob_terms: Terms on review page and invoice
settings.ob_rules_hint: How far ahead devotees can book and booking or invoice number prefixes. Per-service lead days and daily caps are set on each service; blocked dates and slot limits are under Availability.
settings.ob_public_window: Public site booking dates today: {from} through {to} (minimum notice and max horizon from the fields below).
settings.ob_payment_hint: Razorpay keys live in Booking/.env on the server.
settings.ob_upi_manual_on: Manual temple UPI QR is enabled for devotees (legacy mode).
settings.ob_upi_form: Open UPI settings in Booking admin
settings.ob_razorpay_blurb: Devotees pay with Pay now (UPI, card, net banking via Razorpay).
settings.ob_whatsapp_hint: Cloud API credentials in Booking/.env; template names must match Meta.
settings.note: A name already in a list cannot be added again. Names the forms rely on stay in the table and cannot be removed. A pledge is a record on the devotee page. Approval status, invoice status, bank match, user role, and cash-book deposit or withdraw stay fixed.
settings.outgoing_hint: Until a mail server and a From address are saved, messages are written to the notification log only. The password stays hidden. Leave it blank to keep the saved one.
settings.save_scope: Saving here updates mail and WhatsApp only.
settings.whatsapp_hint: This opens WhatsApp Web with the devotee’s number and this message. Nothing is sent through a WhatsApp API.
settings.where.billing_cycles: Subscriptions. The billing cycle box suggests these while typing. Monthly is the cycle counted in monthly recurring revenue.
settings.where.conditions: Inventory, when stock is added and when condition or location is updated.
settings.where.deities: Deity vastra and a vastra gift on Donations.
settings.where.donation_types: Donations. Cash and Other ask for an amount. Food, Vastra, and Inventory open the matching extra fields.
settings.where.expense_categories: Expenses. A stock purchase records its payment under Other.
settings.where.inventory_categories: Inventory on hand, an inventory purchase, and an inventory gift on Donations.
settings.where.movements: Inventory movement. Added is stored when stock comes in. Used is the Food stock usage button.
settings.where.payment_modes: One list for every form. Cash and bank modes enter the books. A mode marked none, such as In-Kind, stays off the cash book.
settings.where.plans: Subscriptions. The plan box suggests these names while typing. Add or remove a plan here.
settings.where.purposes: Donations. A pledge purpose is typed on the devotee page and is not taken from this list.
settings.where.puja_purposes: Legacy list kept in the selections file only. Edit prasadam and services under Online booking › Catalog & pricing.
settings.where.subscriber_statuses: Subscriptions. The status box suggests these while typing. Active is counted in monthly recurring revenue and can receive a new invoice. Active cannot be removed.
settings.where.units: Inventory, Food stock, and an inventory gift on Donations.
settings.where.vastra_statuses: Deity vastra. Approval status and invoice status stay fixed because the books depend on those words.
shell.admin_only: This section is restricted to Admin users.
ui.buy_stock: Buy stock and record the payment
ui.coupon_name_suggest_help: Names and prices come only from Settings › Online booking (Prasadam menu, then Services with a fixed price). Pick one to fill cost per coupon. Refresh this page after you change the online catalog.
ui.coupon_catalog_source: Coupon names, purpose suggestions, and prices match Settings › Online booking (Catalog & pricing).
ui.edit_both: This gift was added more than 24 hours ago. Both a Treasurer and an Admin must approve any change. Neither one is enough, whatever the amount or the field. The gift and its receipt stay as they are until both have approved. The devotee name is shared by every gift from that person.
ui.edit_scope: This gift was added within the last 24 hours. It stays as it is until this edit is approved. A Treasurer can approve it up to the Treasurer limit in Settings. Above that, an Admin decides. The person who submitted it cannot approve it. The devotee name is shared by every gift from that person.
ui.subscriber_status_help: Active: paying, gets new invoices, and counts in monthly revenue. Paused: a short break; set Active again to resume. Inactive: stopped for now and can restart. Cancelled: the devotee asked to stop. Invoices already sent keep their payment links.
ui.coupon_one_ready: Quantity 1 is ready to print at once. It does not wait for approval.
ui.coupon_batch_waits: This quantity waits for approval. It cannot be printed until someone else approves it.
ui.coupon_form_note: Each coupon is stored on its own. Quantity 1 is ready to print at once and does not wait for approval. A larger quantity waits for approval and cannot be printed until someone else approves it. The face value does not enter the books until a coupon is sold. Devotee, donation type, payment, purpose, UPI, and cheque are optional. Leave them blank and a scan is Cash under Coupon counter, with Donation as the purpose. Fill them in and every coupon uses those details. Pick a coupon name from the list and the amount fills from Settings › Online booking. A name that is not in the list keeps the amount you type. Choosing a purpose does not change the amount. You can change the amount before you generate. Choose an expiry, or leave no expiry. A Treasurer can approve a batch up to {limit}. Above that, an Admin decides. The person who prepared the batch cannot approve it.
